event_name: NZ Tap Takeover Feat. 8 Wired, Abandoned, Double Vision, Lakeman & Shining Peak
date_text: Thu, Jun 4th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Jun 7th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Thursday until the kegs run dry, we’re handing the taps over to some of New Zealand’s finest breweries. It’s always a pleasure to see a shipment arrive from across the ditch, especially when it’s loaded with hop bombs like this. We’ve packed the lineup with beers from 8 Wired, Double Vision, Shining Peak, Abandoned and Lakeman, showcasing everything from crisp, session able fresh hop XPAs right through to monster Triple IPAs and a decadent Espresso I Stout weighing in at a hefty 13.5%. So you better get in early. Once they’re gone, they’re gone! Tap List:- - 8 Wired BETELGEUSE Red IPA 6% - 8 Wired DBL ESPRESSO i Stout 13.5% - DVB x SURE FRESH DROP Fresh Hop Pils 5.5% - DVB JAEGER Fresh Hop NZIPA 6.5% - DVB MONARCH Hazy Triple IPA 10.2% - Shining Peak SKUNK JUICE Hazy IPA 6.2% - Shining Peak PEAK PETROL 8.7% IIPA - Abandoned HAZY #19 6.5% - Abandoned FRESH HOP XPA 4.2% 50L - Lakeman HAIRY HOP IIPA 6.3% - Lakeman SNAKE OIL Hazy IPA 6.5% - Lakeman ROGUE HOP West Coast IIPA 8.7%
